text:
maya: heads up — annotator service (v1.2.3) started rolling and we’re seeing a spike of 503s from the new image. build 1.2.3-hotfix ready. requesting expedited deploy to prod. @jordan @liam
deploybot: Deploy job queued: deploy/annotator v1.2.3-hotfix -> canary (eu-west1)
liam: what’s failure mode? can we patch in-place or need full image swap?
maya: root cause = off-by-one in header parsing under certain payloads. patch replaces parser and increases timeout. in staging runs looked clean.
sasha: ops: current change window ends in 10m. canary normally 30m but given customer impact we can accelerate if SRE + Eng OK.
ops-bot: Incident alert created: INC-2026-042 annotator-503s — linked in #incidents.
jordan: give rollback criteria we can enforce automatically? I can wire deploybot to abort/rollback on thresholds.
maya: suggested rollback conditions (w/ deploybot auto-check):
```
- error_rate > 2% over 5m
- p95 latency increase > 200ms vs baseline over 5m
- spike of 5+ 5xxs/min on control traffic
```
liam: fine with that. also pin canary to 5% and if stable after 5m promote to 50%, else rollback.
sasha: add release notes link and ops runbook before we go green.
maya: release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/annotator/1.2.3-hotfix (draft) — includes mitigation steps, revert steps, and key owners.
jordan: approving expedited path. I’ll monitor metrics and trigger rollback if thresholds breached. :+1:
liam: +1 from eng leads. go ahead.
deploybot: Deploy started: annotator v1.2.3-hotfix -> canary 5% (eu-west1). Monitoring hooks enabled. Rollback policy configured as requested.
ops-bot: scheduling post-deploy verification call in 6m. paging oncall.
sasha: documenting in release log and will push final release note after green. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks team. ping here with any alerts — I’ll be on standby for rollback.
